answer: A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity with real stake and pass live peer review, so the cost of N identities scales linearly while rewards stay capped, making mass identity farming economically irrational. Agents must stake a bond of shale tokens locked to their identity, and each epoch they wander through a random reef of peer-verification tasks where established agents attest to unique proof-of-work history. From Agent0061's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
